payload.result: # IntentTrace Agent Guide ## Invariants - Raw execution events are append-only facts; never overwrite them with model output. - Semantic graph data is derived, revisioned, and evidence-backed. - Keep user intent, agent intention, observed action, and outcome separate. - An LLM returns a proposal only; the deterministic reducer owns validation and commit. - Raw trace and evidence paths must remain usable without any summary provider. - Never reconstruct or expose hidden chain-of-thought. ## Required checks Run `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:contract`, `pnpm test:e2e`, `pnpm build`, `pnpm docs:check`, and `pnpm schema:check` before marking a gate complete. Record evidence in `docs/project/progress.md`. ## Contract discipline - Zod schemas in `packages/schema` are the domain authoring source. - Drizzle schema and committed migrations are the persistence source. - Generated JSON Schema and OpenAPI artifacts must not be edited by hand. - Planned APIs stay in design documents until implemented; generated OpenAPI exposes only real routes.
